name: zanker-art-direction
description: Develop distinctive, product-appropriate visual direction grounded in the user context.

workflow.instruction: Read Product DNA and Design System; formulate art direction as an explicit sentence.
Choose typographic character, composition, palette, density, imagery and motion purpose.
Avoid default identical card grids, violet gradients and decorative noise without justification.
Present two or three meaningfully different options through the Design Studio.

fallback: If no product context exists, show assumptions with alternatives.
